parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'ready', license_key: $json.license_key.toUpperCase(), email: $json.email, plan: $json.plan, seats: $json.seats, expires_at: $json.plan === 'team' ? $json.expires : null }.toJsonString() }}

nodes.name: Existing licence
nodes.notes: A Stripe retry of the same event must not mint a second key: the row for this session, if there is one, is what Build licence keeps.

nodes.name: Compose licence email
nodes.notes: Builds the HTML and plain-text licence email from the verified session. Sets skip when there is no address or the event is a Stripe retry.

nodes.name: Send licence email
nodes.notes: The licence key by email, from the Proton account. The page still shows the key whether or not this goes out.

nodes.name: Manual: replacement key
nodes.notes: Someone wrote in with an old licence and needs a fresh key: fill in "Manual request", then run this trigger. A new key is minted, saved to the licence table and emailed to them.

nodes.name: Manual request
nodes.notes: Edit before running: email (required), plan = pro | commercial, seats and company only matter for commercial. Leave source = manual.

nodes.name: Event type
nodes.notes: A checkout mints a licence. A paid subscription invoice or an ended subscription changes a Team row. Anything else Stripe sends stops here.

nodes.name: Re-fetch object
nodes.notes: As with the session: the posted event is not trusted, the invoice or subscription is read back from Stripe.

nodes.name: Team rows
nodes.notes: Every licence this Stripe customer holds; Team change picks the Team ones.
